description: PHP CGI argument injection vulnerability that may allow remote code execution in affected configurations.
mitigation: Upgrade PHP to a fixed version.
Disable exposed CGI configurations where possible.
Block exploit patterns at the WAF while patching.

description: MOVEit Transfer SQL injection vulnerability exploited for unauthorized access and data theft.
mitigation: Rotate secrets and inspect transfer logs.

description: Apache Log4j remote code execution vulnerability known as Log4Shell.
mitigation: Remove vulnerable JndiLookup classes in emergency cases.
Monitor outbound callbacks from Java workloads.
